name: HyperFrames to After Effects
summary: Take your HyperFrames animation into After Effects. Keep editable text, layers and keyframes.
visual_caption: FROM THE WEB. INTO YOUR TIMELINE.

name: Real SFX
summary: Add real sound effects to your motion videos. Claude picks recordings from your library and puts each one on the frame.

name: Flat Highlight video style
summary: Bright product promos: flat colour scenes, words that jump in, one key word on a brand-colour plate, one UI card per scene.

name: Dark Pixel video style
summary: Dark tech promos with one accent colour, a pixel mascot, a browser where a cursor types and clicks, and pixel-stripe shutters.

name: Film Slice 3D video style
summary: One 3D metaphor for video tools: a long video as a film strip, a piece lifts off and lands as a finished clip.

name: Pixel Captions video style
summary: Vertical shorts where the captions are the hero: words light up as they are said, one word on a plate, a pixel scene above.

name: HUD Dashboard video style
summary: A no-cut control panel: a turning point sphere lights up, counters tick, a log grows. A system at work in 20 seconds.

name: Card Carousel 3D video style
summary: Many cards in 3D layouts that flow into each other: a turning ring, an arc, a focus, a fan. For galleries and catalogues.

name: Mono Grid video style
summary: A black-and-white editorial film in four panels. Each panel has its own rhythm, and the panels change one by one.

name: Paper Collage video style
summary: Explainers that look made by hand: torn paper on dark cardboard, cut-out words, typewriter labels and a red thread.

name: Mascot Pastel video style
summary: Friendly promos with a character: pastel scenes that flow into each other, a serif accent word, a phone with the live product.

name: Split Compare video style
summary: Before and after on one frame: a compare slider, BEFORE and AFTER tags, a frame that reshapes, scene changes by a seam.
